_comment: Moves the Ping task off MainTask's priority on the lab controller.
PRG_PING_DMX makes two SysSockPing calls with ulTimeout := 100, and the task
sat at priority 4 - MainTask's own, which runs every 50 ms and drives the
pushbuttons and the covers. Up to 200 ms of blocking at that priority is the
stall FB_OUTPUT_COVER_POSITION_MQTT keeps a cudiMaxTickMs := 500 guard for.
31 is the lowest priority the device allows: the G1 PFC200 description
(0000 0013 / 4.19.0.0) sets maxtaskpriority to 31, unlike the G2's 15. A ping
every 10 s is the one thing here that can always wait.
The task already exists, so this updates it: no interval and no calls are
given, and both are left as they are.
